title: A client with no category matrices has only the General Matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a client whose Pricing page lists only its default matrix.
  • Use the same client after the deploy, with no matrix created since (its Matrices list Audit Log shows no event).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices tab lists one matrix, the General Matrix.
  • The tab label reads Matrices (1).

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
